definitions.explanation: The profession, practice, or industry of gathering, writing, and reporting news. From English 'journalism.' Can also refer to the media world collectively.

examples.japanese: ジャーナリズムの{役割|やくわり}は{大|おお}きい。
examples.english: The role of journalism is significant.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}はジャーナリズムを{学|まな}んでいる。
インターネットの{普及|ふきゅう}によって、ジャーナリズムのあり{方|かた}が{大|おお}きく{変|か}わった。
examples.english: The spread of the internet has greatly changed the nature of journalism.

notes:
A loanword from English 'journalism,' used in both academic and general contexts. Refers to the profession of news reporting as well as the media industry more broadly.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ジャーナリズムの{世界|せかい}: the world of journalism
- ジャーナリズムを{学|まな}ぶ: to study journalism
- {調査|ちょうさ}ジャーナリズム: investigative journalism
- {市民|しみん}ジャーナリズム: citizen journalism
- ジャーナリズム{精神|せいしん}: the spirit of journalism; journalistic ethics

RELATED WORDS:
- ジャーナリスト: journalist
- {報道|ほうどう}: reporting; news coverage — the native Japanese equivalent focusing on the act of reporting
- マスコミ: mass media (abbreviation of マスコミュニケーション) — broader term for media in general
